statements.statement: The patient presents with a recent episode of transient neurological deficits consistent with a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
A 30-day mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is supported by diagnosis code G45.9
The service is supported by diagnosis code Z86.73
The indication for the study is to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential etiology for recurrent ischemic events
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The denial reflects specific coverage limitations of the patient's active Medicaid eligibility
